purpose: Freeze the non-economic execution-normalization interface and independent parity requirements between frozen GA1 semantic masks and the already validated statistical scorer, without inventing runtime-local mask encoding or reading economic PnL.

layer_boundaries.semantic_rematerialization: Produces canonical event identity from the frozen signal configuration/event logic. It may not reuse or invent undocumented runtime-local mask-byte encoding. Production rematerialization must independently reproduce the frozen distinct-class count, semantic root and alias root before execution traversal.
layer_boundaries.execution_normalizer: Consumes explicit rematerialized event anchors plus ordered executable Bid/Ask ticks and produces normalized anchored trades. It applies execution only; it does not choose parameters, dedupe hypotheses, compute statistics or inspect aggregate PnL.
layer_boundaries.statistical_scorer: Already validated W09 component. It consumes normalized candidate rows and may not be modified by W09B.

frozen_execution_semantics.signal_observability: signal_observable_timestamp must not be later than entry_trigger_timestamp and entry fill must use the first really executable ordered tick at or after entry_trigger_timestamp
frozen_execution_semantics.stop_fill: when the executable exit-side quote crosses the fixed opposite-fractal stop, fill at that first really executable quote, including adverse gaps beyond the stop
frozen_execution_semantics.same_day_fill: if no stop occurs, exit on the last executable exit-side quote at or before the exact supplied session_close_timestamp
frozen_execution_semantics.target: none, therefore no TP ambiguity exists in this anchor
frozen_execution_semantics.tick_order: input carrier order is authoritative; timestamps may be equal, so each tick requires a strictly increasing carrier_sequence and nondecreasing timestamp
frozen_execution_semantics.R_numeric: finite base-10 Decimal strings; no display rounding before downstream comparisons

event_anchor_contract.production_origin_requirement: Every event anchor must be emitted by a frozen semantic rematerializer bound to the Seed0076 signal configuration and broker clock/session authority; the execution normalizer may not synthesize missing anchors.
event_anchor_contract.synthetic_fixture_rule: Synthetic W09B tests may provide isolated event anchors explicitly solely to test execution semantics. Synthetic anchors are never production evidence.

synthetic_execution_fixture_contract.why_isolated: The frozen documents retrieved so far do not explicitly bind same-candidate overlapping-signal admission while a prior anchored trade is open. Synthetic parity must not silently choose such a policy.

required_additional_bindings_before_prod: exact broker/session clock authority including session_close_timestamp generation
exact same-candidate overlapping-signal admission policy for anchored GA2 trades
production_rematerialization_contract.if_any_binding_missing: FAIL_CLOSED_BEFORE_ECONOMIC_EXPOSURE; persist exact missing-binding receipt; do not infer, optimize or ask for unrelated repository rediscovery
production_rematerialization_contract.runtime_data_absence: BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE only at production bundle materialization if exact required bytes are unavailable; this does not invalidate W09B source/synthetic parity

decision: W09B MAY BUILD AND EXTERNALLY VALIDATE THE EXECUTION PRIMITIVE ON SYNTHETIC ISOLATED EVENTS; W10 REMAINS LOCKED UNTIL PRODUCTION REMATERIALIZATION, OVERLAP/SESSION/UNIT BINDINGS AND TRADE-BY-TRADE PARITY ARE ALL EXACTLY VERIFIED
